name: Harvest
description: Productivity and project management: time tracking, invoicing, expenses and project budget reporting tool.
access_notes: Personal access tokens and OAuth2 applications are created self-serve from the Developers section of Harvest ID (id.getharvest.com/developers); Harvest offers a free plan and 30-day free trial. Every request needs a Harvest-Account-Id and User-Agent header alongside the Bearer token.
mcp_notes: Official vendor-hosted remote MCP at https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp documented in the Harvest Help Center (time entries, timers, projects, budgets). Composio has a managed HARVEST toolkit (OAuth2, 57 tools). Multiple community MCP servers also exist on GitHub (unofficial).
uncertainty_notes: No webhooks section exists anywhere in the Harvest API v2 documentation index (Clients, Invoices, Estimates, Expenses, Tasks, Timesheets, Projects, Roles, Users, Reports), so supports_webhooks is recorded as false; event notifications require polling or third-party connectors like Zapier.

evidence.note: V2 API supports Personal Access Tokens (created self-serve in Harvest ID Developers section) and full OAuth2 authorization_code flow via id.getharvest.com/oauth2/authorize.
REST API at api.harvestapp.com/v2 with Bearer token, Harvest-Account-Id and required User-Agent headers; supports GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE.
API v2 doc index covers Clients, Invoices, Estimates, Expenses, Tasks, Timesheets, Projects, Roles, Users and Reports (read+write); no webhooks API is listed.
Official Harvest Help Center article: remote MCP server at https://api.harvestapp.com/mcp for timers, time entries and project budgets.
Composio toolkit catalog lists HARVEST: 57 tools, OAuth2, Composio-managed.
